description: Returns usage history for one service, or for the whole account when service_id is empty: connection success, traffic and connection errors over the last 24h, 7d or 30d. In series, bytes_out is downloaded and bytes_in is uploaded. Can lag recent traffic.

service_id.description: Service ID (a UUID) from list_services. Leave empty for the whole account.

name: get_usage_history
title: Get usage history
